name: Komori Airi
source:
A magical girl with little real combat experience yet, who retains some childishness. Precisely because she is an extraordinary being, she burns with a sense of duty to defend the townspeople and fight evil. She is somewhat cocky but generally performs outstandishly, and great results are expected from her in the future. By the way, she likes seniors and prefers grumpy old men.

"Because I am a magical girl".
